_comment: The Consortium supply drop crate (phase 4 and later) (docs/EVENTS.md 3.4, rule 4.1): one Apotheosis affix item, 0 to 2 gems and one cosmetic. Every entry is a PROGRESSION 3 free-forever category or a cosmetic outside every price family; never a priced item, never credits, never a ticket item. Rarities and purities are PLACEHOLDER values tuned in the beta. structure_loot.js leaves consortium:* tables outside the affix strip on purpose. The affix entry resolves the world tier of the player who opens the crate (chest loot context).
